boxes.title: Fa-Hien: added detail
items: Visit c. **399-414 CE**; "Record of Buddhist Kingdoms"
Came overland via **Central Asia**, Gandhara
==**20 viharas at Mathura**==; decay at **Kapilavastu, Gaya, Kushinagar**
Persistent rebellion: right hand cut off
Mild government, light taxes; **rest houses** on highways
Hospitals funded by leading families
Avoided meat, onion, garlic, liquor (except chandalas); Hindus, Buddhists in harmony

boxes.title: Society & women: more
items: **Varnashram Dharma** asserted
Kayasthas = ==**prathama kayastha**== in town councils
Chandalas outside the four varnas
Pre-puberty marriage advocated by **Dharmashastras**
Most women denied education; lower-varna women freer to earn
Sati **rare** under the Guptas

boxes.title: Guilds & inscriptions: more
items: Executive committees; settled internal disputes
Charity: temples, rest houses, assembly halls, gardens
**Gupta, Vakataka** seals name artisans, guilds
Mandsaur: temple built **436-37 CE**; composer **Vatsabhatti**; weavers ==changed professions==; Dashpur = **Pashchimapur**
Indore guild based at ==**Indrapura**==
AP: Satavahana weavers' guild = ==**Kolika Shreni**== (APHQ 2019)

boxes.title: Coins & trade: more
items: Exports: textiles, **gems**, spices; import: China silk = ==**Chinansuka**==
Copper: kakini, karshapana (few); silver for **local** exchange
Byzantine silk trade lasted to about **550 CE**
West Rome collapse = standard cause (APPSC-G2 **2017**); **Sassanid** decline after Islam
Shift to **SE Asia** via Tamralipti; recovery with **Arab** empire from **10th c.**
**Monsoon winds** aided Bay of Bengal voyages
